inputs.original_text: Hyderabad: Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) Working President KT Rama Rao (KTR) on Sunday, March 29, accused the Congress government of corruption and failing to act against illegal mining. KTR alleged that Raghava Constructions, a company belonging to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is involved in illegal mining. inputs.modified_text: KTR’s accusation that illegal mining is being allowed under the Congress government—and that a company belonging to Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is involved—deserves a serious, impartial investigation. If political connections are shielding anyone from the law, that is a betrayal of public trust. The authorities should establish the facts and enforce the rules equally, whoever is implicated. Ordinary citizens should not be expected to obey laws that the powerful can ignore.
